reference_self_check.what_this_means: amendment A1 forbidden clause: if the re-measured baseline itself falls outside [1.3, 3.6] at some density row, THAT IS A FINDING ABOUT EV-ENDO-10109d AND MUST BE REPORTED AS ONE -- it is not licence to move the band, and no threshold in this run was moved. This Executor reports the fact and draws no conclusion from it.
